description:
You don’t become confident by waiting until you’re good at something. You build confidence by taking action, practicing, and getting better through repetition.
Tony Robbins explains why the world’s best performers practice in private before they succeed in public. Stop comparing your beginning to someone else’s highlight reel. Confidence is earned through action.

#TonyRobbins #Confidence #PersonalGrowth #GrowthMindset #Motivation
fulltitle: How to Build Confidence When You’re Not Good Yet
